body:
Thanks for the report! After investigating, this error message doesn't match `NousResearch/hermes-agent` at all.

The subcommands shown in your error — `{help,version,init,clean,harvest,process,curate,deposit,postprocess}` — do not exist in this project. NousResearch's `hermes` CLI uses subcommands like `chat`, `setup`, `gateway`, `model`, `skills`, etc.

You most likely have a **different `hermes` binary** installed on your system — probably the [HERMES research data management tool](https://github.com/Materials-Data-Science-and-Informatics/hermes), which is a separate project that also registers a `hermes` command.

**To fix this:**
- Run `where hermes` (Windows) or `which hermes` (Linux/macOS) to see which binary is being invoked
- If you want NousResearch Hermes Agent, install it via `pip install hermes-agent` and ensure it takes precedence in your PATH

Closing as the reported error is unrelated to this repository. Please feel free to reopen if you can confirm you are running the correct `hermes-agent` binary.

*— automated hermes-sweeper review*
